- scripts/security_audit.sh:3354-3357,3757-3781 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The consolidated follow-up's single `- Depends on: #N` is the highest-numbered same-file predecessor, and its open/closed state is never checked; `LAST_FOLLOWUP_BY_FILE` is seeded from the `-f state=all` listing (line 3356), and existing_finding_numbers/index rows (`-\t-\t{file_key}\t{number}`) record no issue state.
  WHY: The README row this PR adds says "the highest-numbered open same-file predecessor", and test_security_audit_consolidated_followup_depends_on_highest_same_file_predecessor (tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py:4840-4860) locks in closed #9105 over open #9100; scripts/security_dependency.py:89-91 releases the hold once #9105 is closed with `ai:merged`, so the consolidated fix edits file_b.py while #9100 is still open, which is the same-file race #4934 prevents (minimax adds that the per-file chain at 3797-3805 records the new number under all `FOLLOWUP_MULTI_KEYS`, which compounds the problem); all reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1142-1143 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The 180 s `RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS` deadline is checked only at the top of each per-item iteration, so the item's API requests (marker check, comment POST, PATCH close at lines 1150-1168 / 1194-1200) are not bounded by the remaining time.
  WHY: `_github_api_request` (266-280, 238-242) uses `urlopen(request, timeout=120)` per attempt with up to 3 attempts plus backoff, so an item that starts near the deadline can run past the 5-minute job timeout in `.github/workflows/sync_ai_labels.yml:43`; the job is then killed without emitting `LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_DEFERRED reason=budget` (1235-1236) or an `errors[]` entry, and the new defer path has no test (tests/test_ai_labels_retired.py); all three rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml, .github/workflows/plan.yml, scripts/ai_labels.py:N/A (files modified in last run) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The last AI autofix run introduced unrelated changes for P3a (failure-fingerprint markers) and P11a (retired-label drain deadline).
  WHY: These changes are outside the scope of issue #8821, violate "No new scripts, workflows, supervisors or GitHub API calls", and cause the tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py CI failure (reported as BLOCKER; minimax and glm raised the same concern as a task gap rated MAJOR; sonnet rejected it on the grounds that the hunks are absent from pr_changed_files.txt and came in with base/integration content).
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2347 (and .github/workflows/plan.yml:3505) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `// .id` fallback does not handle a missing or non-matching `check_run_url`, because `capture()` errors instead of yielding `null`.
  WHY: `|| true` suppresses the jq error and leaves `FP_JOB_ID` empty, so no annotations are fetched, no fingerprint marker is emitted, and the fingerprint breaker cannot identify repeated plan/clarify failures (MAJOR; disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash each say `capture` emits no output on non-match, so the fallback runs).
- scripts/security_audit.sh:3548,3637-3640 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The tracker comment labels `len(planned_followups)` as the number of follow-up issues, but in consolidated mode that count is findings, not issues.
  WHY: A cycle with three new findings files one issue but reports "New follow-up issues planned this run: 3", which contradicts the consolidated-mode line that follows (NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh:3760-3777 (multi:* branch; index rows 3751-3756; listing 3356 `-f state=all`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The consolidated follow-up's one `- Depends on:` is the highest issue number among same-file predecessors, and open/closed state is never checked, which contradicts the README "highest-numbered open same-file predecessor"; the test locks in `Depends on: #9105` (closed) over open #9100.
  WHY: scripts/security_dependency.py `security_dependency_verdict` (lines 89-90) returns `ready` once the prerequisite is closed with `ai:merged`, so the file_b.py fix races open #9100, which weakens #4934 serialization against the per-finding path. Fix: carry state into the index row and prefer an open predecessor, or correct the README/agents.d/changelog wording.
- HARDENING: scripts/security_audit.sh ~3471-3483 (`issue_finding_ids = [match.group(1).strip(), *leading_marker_ids(body)]`) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: The dedupe reads leading markers of any `ai:security` issue whatever its author, so one issue can suppress many finding IDs.
  WHY: The review gate still fails closed (`followups_missing`), so the cost is a stuck hold. Fix: apply leading_marker_ids only for the pipeline author (3-5 lines).
- NOTE: rejected pass-1 findings: the jq `check_run_url` fallback (capture yields no output, so `// .id` works); the ai_labels.py drain deadline and the scope contamination (files are not in pr_changed_files.txt and came from base/integration); the copilot `custom_instructions_too_large` (HTTP 422) failure is external.
- TASK GAPS: NONE (all #8821 deliverables present).
